Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION ( FOR DINING TABLES

First Revision )

0. FOREWORD
0.1 This Indian Standard

( First Revision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 30 May 1986, after the draft finalized by the Furniture Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council.

0.2 This standard was first published in 1970. A revision of the standard has been taken up to review the same in the light of experience gained during the period that has elapsed since its last publication. This revision makes reference to the recent Indian Standards for various types of materials allowed in the standard. The major changes made in this revision are given below: a) New material for the components such as particle board, veneered particle board, block board and decorative plastic laminates are included; b) Height of tables has been modified; and c) Recommendations for finish of tables have been given in detail. 0.3 In the formulation of this standard, due weightage has been given to international co-ordination among the standards and practices prevailing in different countries in addition to relating it to the practices in this deld in this country.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard covers requirements for materials, dimensions of all types of dining tables. 2. MATERIALS 2.1 Wooden Tops -

2.5 Aluminium Sheets - Aluminium sheets shall conform to alloy designation 31500 or 40800 in Hz condition of IS : 737-19747. 2.6 Aluminium Tubes - Aluminium tubes shall conform to designation 62400, 63400 or 65032 of IS : 1285-19758. 2.7 Screws - Screws shall conform to IS : 1365-l 9789 or IS : 6760-l 972lO. 2.8 Particle Board - Wood particle board required for the manufacture of dining tables shall conform to IS : 3087-198611 and shall be of type flat pressed three-layer type. In case single layer particle boards are used, these shall conform to type FPSI of IS : 3087-198611. 2.9 Veneered Particle Board - Veneered particle board used for the manufacture of dining tables shall conform to IS : 3097-19801". Both interior and exterior grade veneered particle boards may be used where air-drying paints or varnishes are to be used. Where suitable baking paints, enamels or varnishes are to be used, only exterior grade veneered particle board shall be used. 2.10 Blockboard - Blockboard used shall conform to IS : 1659-197913 and shall be of Grade I if air-drying finishes are adopted and Grade II if suitable oven-drying finishes are adopted.

Any of the three grades of plywood, that is, BWR, WWR and CWR can be used where air-drying paints, enamels or varnishes are to be used or where the plywood is to be covered by decorating laminates. Where finishing is to be done with suitable oven-drying paints, enamels or varnishes only BWR grade of plywood shall be used. The plywood used shallnot be inferior to Type B.

2.11Plywood - Plywood used shall conform to IS : 303-1975*.

2.12 Timber -Any of the species of timber recommended for furniture and cabinet making in IS ~:399-19637 shall be used in the manufacture of dicing tables. The maximum moisture content of the timber used shall conform to 3.1, 4.1 and Table 1 of IS : 287-1973$. The specification for timber shall conform to Grade 1, non-structural of IS : 133 l-197 I$ 2.13 Decorative Plastic Laminates - Decorative plastic laminates used shall conform to IS : 2046-196911and shall be of the design and finish as prescribed by the purchaser. 2.14 Adhesives - Adhesive used for joinery work shall conform to IS : 849-19577, IS : 851-1978**, IS : 852-1969tt and IS : 4835-19791:. 3. DIMENSIONS 3.1 Height of the table should be 710 to 730 mm while the free space between the underside of the table top including frame members, if any, and floor should be not less than 610 mm. NOTE - The dimensions of the seating place at the table shall be as shown in Fig. 1.
The dimensions of the table top are determined according to the number of persons for which the table is provided.

4. SHAPE 4.1 The shape, design and dimensions shall be appropriately chosen according to the purpose, taking into consideration the different standards The shape of the table top may be rectangular, square or on furniture. circular.

5. FINISH

DIMENSIONS OF SEATINGPLACE AT THE TABLE

5.1 All dents, burrs and sharp edges shall be removed from the various components. The components shall be individually pickled, scrubbed and rinsed to remove grease, rust, scale or any other foreign element. 5.2 Immediately after pickhng, all the mild steel parts shall be given phosphating treatment conforming to Class C of IS : 3618-1966*. The process for application of phosphate coating shall be in accordance with IS : 60051970t. 5.3 Putty may be applied for filling and smoothening the surface, if required. This shall conform to IS : 1 lo-19831. 5.4 Finish coat/coats of enamel paint shall then be applied. The enamel paint shall conform to IS : 151-19509, IS : 2932-19741)or IS : 2933-19757.
FSpecification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion. tcodc of practice for phosphating of iron and steel. #Specification for ready mixed paint, brushing, grey filler, for enamels, for use over primers ( second revision ) . $Specification for ready mixed paint, spraying, finishing, stoving enamel, for general purposes, colour as required. eci ca ion for enamel, synthetic, exterior (a) undercoating, (b) finishing (jrst rrvi!isopn ).fi t fspecification for enamel, exterior (a) undercoating, (b) finishing (Jirsr r&ion ) .

6

IS : 5823- 1986 5.4,1 The components shall thereafter be baked at a specified temperature in an oven heated uniformly. The finish shall be smooth a.nd uniform with a hard and tough film of enamel strong adhering to the surface. The finish shall be free from all visible defects and shall not chip when tapped lightly with a dull pointed instrument. 5.5 Aluminium parts in the table may be anodized, if required by the purchaser and the manufacturer. 5.5.1 Aluminium primer shall conform to 1s : 5660-1970*. 5.6 Welding of aluminium parts shall be in accordance with IS : 281219647. 5.7 All components shall be finished in colour as agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 5.8 For finishing wooden components the surface shall be lacquered, polished, varnished, melamine or polyster coated. The method of application of finish shall conform to IS : 2338 ( Parts 1 and 2 )-1967$ and the other relevant Indian Standards wherever they exist. 6. MARKING 6.1 Dining tables shall be marked with a suitable mark identifying the manufacturer. 6.1.1 The dining tables may also be marked with the IS1 Certification Mark.
NOTE- The use of the IS1 Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks) Act and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. Presence of this mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard, under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control during production. This system, which is devised and supervised by ISI and operated by the producer, has the further safeguard that the products as actually marketed are continuously checked by IS1 for conformity to the standard. Details of conditions, under which a licence for the use of the IS1 -Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution.

The minimum qualifying average rating shall conform to 8 of IS : 5807 (Part 4)-19757. 7.8 Resistance of Surface to Mechanical Damage - The test sample surface shall be tested for impact, cross-cut and scrape tests in accordance with IS : 5807 ( Part 6 )-197&t.
